name: construct-constraints-v1
note: E14 Y1: constrained polynomial construction; sympy-graded, references verified.

items.prompt: Construct a single-variable polynomial p(x) with ALL of these properties: degree exactly 2; integer coefficients; a root at x = 3 (so p(3) = 0); leading coefficient 1. Output ONLY the polynomial as an equation on a final line prefixed by '#### ', in the form '#### p(x) = 0'. Example: '#### x**2 - 5*x + 6 = 0'.
